import random

def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    base=[v for row in grid for v in row]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # The expanded image contains four copies of the original colors; retain the
    # first copy and rearrange the other copies as independent permutations.
    for block in range(1,4):
        vals=base[:]
        seed=0
        for r,row in enumerate(grid):
            for c,v in enumerate(row):
                seed=(seed*131 + v*17 + r*7 + c*3 + 1) & 0xffffffff
        random.Random(seed+block*7919).shuffle(vals)
        tile=[vals[r*n:(r+1)*n] for r in range(n)]
        for r in range(n):
            if block==1:
                out[r].extend(tile[r])
            else:
                out.append(tile[r] if block==2 else [])
        if block==3:
            # compose lower-right with lower-left in same rows
            for r in range(n):
                out[n+r].extend(tile[r])
    return out
PY
